description: This file defines the LDAPAuthProvider class within the LDAP module of the OrangeHRM system. It encapsulates the data related to an LDAP authentication provider including user distinguished name (DN) and user ID.

classes.name: LDAPAuthProvider
classes.description: Represents LDAP authentication provider data, namely the user's distinguished name and user ID.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes an LDAPAuthProvider with a user DN and user ID.
